normalization_policy: Original graphs train all models. Salt-neutralized parent and canonical tautomer are screening keys only; tautomer normalization may remove stereochemical detail and does not prove interchangeable biological activity. No salts, charge or stereochemistry are silently edited in source inputs.

probe_challenge.design: One exposed probe pair; positive difference agrees with its published potency ordering but cannot establish potency prediction. No AUC or significance claim. NC is weakly inhibitory, not inactive. Species/construct unspecified; NC stereochemistry assumed by source. Database counter-screen and lysate apparent Kd are separate evidence tiers/endpoints.
